<body>
<header>
  <div class="brand">Vasari</div>
  <button id="loadBtn"><span class="lbl">Load export</span></button>
  <button id="importBtn" title="Merge a previously exported feedback JSON"><span class="lbl">Import feedback</span></button>
  <div class="banner" id="banner">No data loaded</div>
  <div class="spacer"></div>
  <button id="anonBtn" title="Redact PII in the timeline, exports, and LLM payloads"><span class="lbl">Anonymize</span></button>
  <button id="analyzeBtn" title="Cluster error codes into categories (open → axial coding)"><span class="lbl">Analyze fails</span></button>
  <button id="judgesBtn" title="LLM-as-judge per failure category — validate vs human labels, then export"><span class="lbl">Judges</span></button>
  <button id="exportCsv"><span class="lbl">Export CSV</span></button>
  <button id="exportJson"><span class="lbl">Export JSON</span></button>
  <button id="settingsBtn" title="Settings — API key & anonymization"></button>
  <input type="file" id="fileInput" accept=".json,.ndjson,application/json,text/plain" class="hidden" />
  <input type="file" id="fbInput" accept=".json,application/json" class="hidden" />
</header>

<main>
  <aside class="queue">
    <div class="queue-head">
      <div class="progress">
        <span><b id="revCount">0</b> / <b id="totalCount">0</b> reviewed</span>
        <span><b id="passCount">0</b> pass</span>
        <span><b id="failCount">0</b> fail</span>
      </div>
      <div class="filters" id="filters">
        <button data-f="all" class="active">All</button>
        <button data-f="unreviewed">Unreviewed</button>
        <button data-f="pass">Pass</button>
        <button data-f="fail">Fail</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="catFilterNote"></div>
    <div class="queue-list" id="queueList"></div>
  </aside>

  <section class="detail">
    <div class="detail-head" id="detailHead"></div>
    <div class="timeline" id="timeline">
      <div class="empty" id="emptyState">
        <h2>Load an OpenTelemetry trace export to begin</h2>
        <p>Click <b>Load export…</b> or drag a <code>.json</code> / <code>.ndjson</code> file anywhere onto this window.</p>
        <p style="font-size:13px">Works with OTLP exports, OpenInference / gen_ai spans, Langfuse exports,
        or plain <code>[{role, content}]</code> conversations — and falls back to readable JSON for anything else.</p>
        <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">
          Shortcuts once loaded: <span class="kbd">j</span>/<span class="kbd">k</span> navigate ·
          <span class="kbd">p</span> pass · <span class="kbd">f</span> fail ·
          <span class="kbd">/</span> comment · <span class="kbd">c</span> code · <span class="kbd">⌘/Ctrl+↵</span> save & next
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback hidden" id="feedback">
      <div class="fb-main">
        <div class="verdict-btns">
          <button class="pass" id="btnPass">Pass</button>
          <button class="fail" id="btnFail">Fail</button>
        </div>
        <textarea id="comment" placeholder="Comment — what did the agent do well or badly? (autosaves)"></textarea>
        <div class="savenote" id="saveNote"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="fb-codes hidden" id="fbCodes">
        <label>Error codes</label>
        <div class="chips" id="codeChips"></div>
        <input type="text" id="codeInput" list="codeSuggestions" placeholder="open code — type & press Enter (e.g. hallucinated data)" />
        <datalist id="codeSuggestions"></datalist>
        <label class="chk" title="I captured every failure category present — makes this a trustworthy negative for judge evaluation"><input type="checkbox" id="fullyCoded" /> fully coded</label>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>
</main>

<div id="analysis" class="modal hidden">
  <div class="modal-card">
    <div class="modal-head">
      <h2>Error analysis — open → axial coding</h2>
      <button id="closeAnalysis"></button>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body" id="analysisBody"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="settings" class="modal hidden">
  <div class="modal-card">
    <div class="modal-head">
      <h2>Settings</h2>
      <button id="closeSettings"></button>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body" id="settingsBody"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="judges" class="modal hidden">
  <div class="modal-card modal-wide">
    <div class="modal-head">
      <h2>LLM-as-judge — validate per category, then export</h2>
      <button id="closeJudges"></button>
    </div>
    <div class="modal-body" id="judgesBody"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="drop">Drop trace export to load</div>

</body>
</html>
